features.label: Soft doeskin material
features.text: Silver colored fabric provides everyday comfort against the thigh to reduce friction.

features.label: Replacement thigh liner
features.text: Refreshes the interior contact surface of the Rebound DUAL OTS frame.

features.label: Easy installation
features.text: Detaches from and reattaches to the frame hook and loop backing quickly without tools.

features.label: For legacy ots frames
features.text: Designed specifically for Rebound DUAL OTS Legacy brace frames and not the ST model.

features.label: Supports ligament bracing
features.text: Pairs with the Rebound DUAL brace used for ACL, MCL, LCL, and PCL injuries.

measurement: Order the thigh liner in the same size as the Rebound DUAL OTS brace already in use, XS to 3XL. Brace sizing is based on thigh circumference measured 6 in. above mid patella, ranging from 15 to 30 in. across the size range. No new measurement is required to order a replacement liner. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
